message:
feat(verify): scoped StrykerJS mutation testing with incremental CI

Adds pnpm mutate (StrykerJS 10.1.1, vitest runner) over domain, server/db,
the log store and sync loop, and the data-build parsers. Baseline 85.61%;
break threshold 83. CI runs incrementally on PRs touching those paths and
on main, with a weekly full run; the incremental file lives in the Actions
cache. Lint allows a reasoned 'Stryker disable next-line' directive.
ci(mutation): cold PRs mutate only changed files; allow full runs on 2-core runners
ci: run mutation testing on demand only, with stable timeouts

Merge pull request #27 from jasontd92/ws10-canary-budgets

ci: production sync canary and blocking performance budgets

feat(verify): tests come from a separate oracle session

- scripts/provenance.ts: CI fails a PR whose non-merge commits change tests (*.spec.ts, *.e2e.ts, verification.yaml) without a Verified-by: oracle trailer.
- scripts/hooks/guard.ts (.claude/settings.json PreToolUse): refuses test commits outside ROLE=oracle, the trailer outside the oracle, and gh pr merge unless every check is green.
- .claude/agents/oracle.md and pnpm oracle: the oracle runs as its own headless session.
- *.local.spec.ts is gitignored for implementers' own checks.
- AGENTS.md (imported by CLAUDE.md): roles, what needs an oracle, and the verification-ledger comment.

feat(verify): a verification ledger per PR, with cost per check

verification/ledger/<pr>.json records which check caught each mistake, whether it was real, and per-check cost (CI minutes from check runs, agent tokens). pnpm ledger draft <pr> adds programmatic catches and costs; pnpm ledger prints real catches and cost per real catch for every check. Linked from the README.
